VBO:0200684.summary: Playful and closely bonded in Dogs Friends’ account, Dakota and Tikani offer an individual glimpse of the Huskamute, an Alaskan Malamute–Siberian Husky cross also called Alusky. The pair gained comfort from each other and enjoyed being outdoors. The charity also described strong, excitable lead walking and vocal habits.
VBO:0200684.shortDescription: An Alaskan Malamute–Siberian Husky cross; Dakota and Tikani’s rescue story pairs close-bonded play with outdoor enthusiasm.
